# Canton Network Docs

## Getting Started

New here, or helping someone get a first app running? Start with these before anything else below:

- [Canton Network QuickStart](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/quickstart.md): The fastest path to a working app -- a full-stack Daml + Java + React application you run locally on LocalNet
- [Choose Your Path](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/get-started/choose-your-path.md): Find the right starting point based on background and goals
- [Who Should Use This Documentation](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/who-should-read.md): Role-based routing into the rest of the docs
- [Module 1: Understanding Canton](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/modules/m1-understanding-canton.md): Core concepts before writing any code
- [MCP Server](https://docs.canton.network/shared/mcp-server.md): Connect an agent directly to search and read these docs, instead of relying on this index alone

## Overview

### Welcome

- [What is Canton Network?](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/what-is-canton.md): Privacy-enabled blockchain for regulated assets and multi-party workflows
- [Who Should Use This Documentation](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/who-should-read.md): Find the right starting point based on your role and goals
- [Canton Network in 5 Minutes](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/five-minute-overview.md): A rapid introduction to Canton Network's approach to privacy-preserving blockchain

### Why Canton?

- [The Problem Canton Solves](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/the-problem.md): Understanding the privacy vs. public visibility tradeoff in blockchain systems
- [Canton's Solution: Three Pillars](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/cantons-solution.md): How Canton achieves privacy without sacrificing integrity
- [Use Cases](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/use-cases.md): Real-world applications where Canton's privacy model enables solutions not feasible on traditional blockchains

### Core Concepts

- [Core Concepts](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/core-concepts.md): Essential building blocks of Canton Network: parties, validators, synchronizers, and smart contracts

### Global Synchronizer

- [The Global Synchronizer](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/global-synchronizer.md): Public infrastructure backbone of Canton Network
- [Canton Coin and the Global Synchronizer](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/canton-coin.md): Understanding Canton Coin's role in the network economy
- [Canton Improvement Proposals (CIPs)](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/cips-introduction.md): Introduction to the CIP process for Canton Network standards and governance
- [Getting Your App Featured](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/getting-app-featured.md): How to get your application listed and promoted on Canton Network

### Architecture

- [Architecture Overview](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/architecture.md): Visual understanding of how Canton Network components work together
- [Privacy Model Explained](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/privacy-model.md): Deep understanding of Canton's unique sub-transaction privacy capabilities
- [Two-Layer Consensus](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/two-layer-consensus.md): How Canton separates smart contract validation from transaction ordering to achieve both privacy and integrity
- [The Ledger Model](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/ledger-model.md): Understanding Canton's UTXO-based ledger model with contracts, stakeholders, and transactions
- [Trust Model Overview](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/trust-model.md): Understanding who you trust and what you trust them for in Canton Network
- [Multi-Synchronizer Architecture](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/multi-synchronizer.md): How contracts are assigned to synchronizers and moved between them
- [Validator Architecture](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/validator-architecture.md): Internal components of a Canton Network validator node
- [Global Synchronizer Architecture](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/global-synchronizer-architecture.md): How the Global Synchronizer coordinates transactions across the Canton Network
- [How Transactions Work](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/how-transactions-work.md): The four-step transaction lifecycle in Canton
- [Cryptographic keys in Canton](https://docs.canton.network/overview/learn/cryptographic-keys.md): Storage of secrets, key types, and key management in Canton. Covers offline, in-memory, KMS envelope encryption, and full KMS options.

### Protocol Deep Dive

- [Canton Protocol Specification](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/canton-protocol-specification.md): Technical specification of the Canton protocol architecture, covering consensus layers, transaction processing, and topology management
- [Ledger Model (Detailed)](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/ledger-model-detailed.md): Formal specification of Canton's ledger model: structure, validity, integrity, privacy, and multi-synchronizer interoperability.
- [Causality and Time](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/ledger-causality.md): Causality graphs, local ledgers, and time on Daml ledgers.
- [Smart Contract Consensus](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/smart-contract-consensus.md): Proof of Stakeholder consensus in Canton — peer-to-peer validation, privacy-preserving consensus, and trust domain analysis
- [Ordering Consensus](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/ordering-consensus.md): Synchronizer ordering architecture — sequencers, mediators, BFT ordering service, and the ISS-inspired consensus protocol
- [Transaction Lifecycle](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/transaction-lifecycle.md): Complete five-phase lifecycle of a Canton transaction — from preparation through sequencing, validation, and final commit
- [Topology](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/topology.md): Canton topology management: namespaces, cryptographic keys, party-to-participant mappings, authorization chains, and topology transactions.
- [Decentralization](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/decentralization.md): Decentralized namespaces, decentralized parties, and decentralized synchronizer ownership in Canton.
- [Local and External Parties](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/external-party.md): Local and external parties, hosting relationships, and the distinction between native and externally signed parties.
- [Synchronizer](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/synchronizer-overview.md): Overview of the Canton Synchronizer: role in architecture, technical components, and centralized vs. decentralized forms.
- [Pruning](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/pruning.md): How Canton pruning works: retention, safe-to-prune markers, and coordination across participant and synchronizer.
- [Reassignment Protocol](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/reassignment-protocol.md): Technical reference for the synchronizer reassignment protocol, covering unassignment, assignment, validation rules, and confirmation policies
- [Cross-Synchronizer DvP Example](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/cross-sync-dvp-example.md): Worked example of Delivery-versus-Payment settlement across multiple synchronizers using Canton's reassignment protocol

### Component Architecture

- [Validator Node Components](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/validator-node-components.md): Detailed breakdown of validator node components, APIs, data stores, and connectivity layers
- [Participant Node Architecture](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/participant-overview.md): How the Canton participant node works: its role in the distributed ledger, privacy model, transaction validation, and API exposure.
- [Super Validator Components](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/super-validator-components.md): Detailed breakdown of the components that make up a Super Validator node on the Global Synchronizer

### Global Synchronizer & Tokenomics

- [Canton Coin Tokenomics](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/canton-coin-tokenomics.md): Technical reference for Canton Coin fees, minting rounds, activity records, and burn-mint equilibrium
- [Tokenomics of the Global Synchronizer](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/tokenomics-of-gs.md): Economic model sustaining the Global Synchronizer: traffic fees, reward distribution, issuance, and the CC-USD conversion rate
- [Canton Name Service](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/canton-name-service.md): Human-readable names mapped to party identifiers on Canton Network
- [Splice Wallet Reference](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/splice-wallet-reference.md): Reference documentation for the built-in Splice wallet, covering Canton Coin operations, automation, transfer workflows, APIs, and UTXO management
- [SV Governance Reference](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/sv-governance-reference.md): Governance model, voting mechanics, and governance actions for the Decentralized Synchronizer Operator (DSO)
- [CF Policies](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/gsf-policies.md): Canton Foundation policies and governance framework

### CIPs

- [CIP Reference](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/what-are-cips.md): Formal structure, lifecycle, and governance mechanics of Canton Improvement Proposals (CIPs)
- [CIP Index](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/cip-index.md): Reference index of Canton Improvement Proposals (CIPs) by type, number, and status
- [CIP-0056: Canton Network Token Standard](https://docs.canton.network/overview/reference/cip-0056.md): Reference for CIP-0056, the standard Daml interfaces for token holdings, transfers, and allocations on Canton Network

### CIP Registry

- [Canton Improvement Proposals (CIPs)](https://docs.canton.network/ai-context/cip-registry.md): Every Canton Improvement Proposal for the Global Synchronizer: what it is about, its current status, and where to read the full text.

### Resources

- [Research Publications](https://docs.canton.network/shared/research.md): Research publications explaining Daml, Canton, and their underlying theory
- [Glossary](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/glossary.md): Authoritative terminology reference for Canton Network concepts
- [Support Channels](https://docs.canton.network/shared/support-channels.md): Getting help with Canton Network development and operations
- [Support Checklist](https://docs.canton.network/shared/support-checklist.md): Information to gather before contacting Canton support for troubleshooting.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.canton.network/shared/mcp-server.md): Connect an AI agent directly to search and read these docs via the Model Context Protocol

- [App Development (110 pages)](https://docs.canton.network/_llms/app-development.txt): Documentation for App Development.
- [Global Synchronizer (123 pages)](https://docs.canton.network/_llms/global-synchronizer.txt): Documentation for Global Synchronizer.
- [Integrations (144 pages)](https://docs.canton.network/_llms/integrations.txt): Documentation for Integrations.

## SDKs and Tools

### Overview

- [SDKs and Tools](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/overview.md): Overview of the development tools ecosystem for building applications on Canton Network.

### SDKs

- [Daml SDK](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/daml-sdk.md): Install and use the Daml SDK for developing smart contracts and applications on Canton.

#### Wallet SDK

- [Overview](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/overview.md): TypeScript library for interacting with the Canton Network.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/quickstart.md): Install the Wallet SDK, configure it, create a key pair and party, and create and submit a transfer.
- [Wallet SDK](https://docs.canton.network/integrations/release-notes/wallet-sdk.md): Release notes for the Canton Network Wallet SDK

##### Using the SDK

- [Configuration](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/configuration.md): Configure the Wallet SDK for the right environment and configuring authentication.
- [Registering Plugins](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/registering-plugins.md): Extend the Wallet SDK with custom methods using the plugin system.

###### v0 to v1 migration

- [SDK v0 to v1 Migration Guide](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration.md): Migrate the Wallet SDK from v0 to v1.
- [Migration cheat sheet](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/migration-cheat-sheet.md): Quick v0 to v1 Wallet SDK method mapping reference.
- [Party Namespace](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/party.md): Migrate party management from Wallet SDK v0 to v1.
- [Token Namespace](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/token.md): Migrate token transfers, holdings, UTXOs, and allocations from v0 to v1.
- [User Namespace](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/user.md): Migrate user management and rights from Wallet SDK v0 to v1.
- [Amulet Namespace](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/amulet.md): Migrate Canton Coin, traffic, preapprovals, and tap from v0 to v1.
- [Ledger Namespace](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/ledger.md): Migrate prepare/sign/execute, ACS, and DAR operations from v0 to v1.
- [Asset Namespace](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/using-the-sdk/v0-to-v1-migration/asset.md): Migrate asset discovery and registry lookups from v0 to v1.

##### Guides

- [Creating an External Party](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/creating-an-external-party.md): Create and onboard an external party: key pairs, mnemonics, party hints, fingerprints, and topology transactions.
- [Finding and Reading Data From the Ledger](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/finding-and-reading-data.md): Read parties, ledger end, and active contracts; stream and monitor transaction history; fetch transactions by updateId.
- [Preparing and Signing a Transaction](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/preparing-and-signing-a-transaction.md): The end-to-end external-party signing flow: build a command, select UTXOs, prepare, validate, visualize, sign, submit, and observe a transaction.
- [Transfer Types](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/transfer-types.md): Two-step vs one-step transfers / pre-approvals, accepting/rejecting/withdrawing two-step transfers, and transfer pre-approvals.
- [Performing a CC Tap on DevNet or LocalNet](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/performing-a-cc-tap.md): Tap Canton Coin for a party on DevNet or LocalNet.
- [Signing Transactions from Third-Party dApps](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/signing-transactions-from-third-party-dapps.md): Receive, read, visualize, and sign transactions submitted by third-party dApps.
- [User Management](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/wallet-sdk/guides/user-management.md): Create users and configure ledger read/act rights, including canReadAsAnyParty and canExecuteAsAnyParty.

#### dApp SDK

- [Overview](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/overview.md): Connect your application to Canton Network wallets with the dApp SDK.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/quickstart.md): Install the dApp SDK and build a working wallet connection in a few minutes.
- [dApp SDK](https://docs.canton.network/integrations/release-notes/dapp-sdk.md): Release notes for the Canton Network dApp SDK

##### Guides

- [Connect & Sessions](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/guides/connect-and-sessions.md): Initialize the SDK, connect a wallet, restore sessions, and disconnect.
- [Parties & Transactions](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/guides/parties-and-transactions.md): Read parties, sign messages, execute transactions, and query the ledger.
- [Handle Events](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/guides/handle-events.md): Subscribe to connection, account, and transaction events, and clean up listeners.
- [Wallet Discovery](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/guides/wallet-discovery.md): Customize the wallet picker, add WalletConnect, and register custom remote wallets.

##### API Reference

- [SDK Methods](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/reference/sdk-methods.md): Reference for the high-level dApp SDK methods.
- [Events](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/reference/events.md): Connection, account, and transaction events emitted by the dApp SDK.
- [Provider API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/reference/provider-api.md): The low-level CIP-103 provider interface behind the dApp SDK.
- [Errors](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/reference/errors.md): Standard error codes returned by the dApp API.

##### Wallet Providers

- [Integration Overview](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/wallet-providers/integration-overview.md): How wallet providers make themselves discoverable to Canton dApps.
- [Browser Extension](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/wallet-providers/browser-extension.md): Make a browser-extension wallet discoverable by announcing it to dApps.
- [Remote Wallet](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/wallet-providers/remote-wallet.md): Expose a remote (server-side) wallet to Canton dApps via a CIP-103 RPC endpoint.
- [WalletConnect](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/sdks/dapp-sdk/wallet-providers/walletconnect.md): Connect mobile and cross-device wallets to Canton dApps via WalletConnect.

### Language Bindings

- [Java Codegen](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/language-bindings/java.md): Generate and use type-safe Java classes from your Daml contracts for Canton backend development.
- [Java LAPI Bindings](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/language-bindings/java-client-libraries.md): Overview, installation, and reference for the Canton Java client libraries (bindings-java).
- [Ledger Client Standard](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/language-bindings/client-standard.md): Capability standard for Canton Ledger Client Libraries, including existing and upcoming functionality.
- [JavaScript Codegen](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/language-bindings/javascript.md): Generate JavaScript/TypeScript bindings from Daml interfaces and templates.
- [Community Bindings](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/language-bindings/community.md): Community-maintained language bindings for Python, Rust, Go, C#, and other languages on Canton.

### CLI Tools

- [dpm (Daml Package Manager)](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/cli-tools/dpm.md): Command reference and configuration for dpm, the primary CLI tool for Canton development.
- [Canton Console](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/cli-tools/canton-console.md): Scala REPL for managing Canton nodes, topology, and debugging operational issues.
- [Daml Script](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/cli-tools/daml-script.md): Write and run test scripts for Daml smart contracts using Daml Script and dpm test.
- [Daml Shell](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/cli-tools/daml-shell.md): Interactive command-line tool for inspecting and debugging the Canton ledger

### Development Tools

- [Daml Studio](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/daml-studio.md): VS Code extension for writing Daml smart contracts with syntax highlighting, type checking, and inline diagnostics.
- [The Daml Compiler](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/daml-compiler.md): Daml compiler flags and invocation options.
- [Daml Profiler](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/daml-profiler.md): Component how-to: Daml Profiler
- [LocalNet](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/localnet.md): Run a multi-validator Canton Network locally with Docker Compose for development and integration testing.
- [Sandbox](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/sandbox.md): Run a local Canton node for rapid development and testing with dpm sandbox.
- [Darsyncer Docker Image](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/darsyncer.md): Upload and synchronize DAR files to a participant.

#### Splice Portfolio dApp UI

- [Overview](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/overview.md): A reference dApp wallet UI for viewing and interacting with assets on Canton.
- [First-Time Setup](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/first-time-setup.md): Deploy the Splice Portfolio UI and connect it to a wallet provider.
- [Navigation](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/navigation.md): Understand the Splice Portfolio layout: parties, dashboard, offers, and settings.
- [Transfers](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/transfers.md): Send, withdraw, accept, and reject transfer offers in Splice Portfolio.
- [Allocations](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/allocations.md): Allocate assets to allocation requests and withdraw allocations in Splice Portfolio.
- [Add a Registry](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/add-a-registry.md): Add a registry to Splice Portfolio so its assets are visible and transferable.
- [Enable Pre-Approvals](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/pre-approvals.md): Pre-authorize incoming transfers of an asset so they are accepted automatically.
- [DevNet Faucet](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/devnet-faucet.md): Use the faucet to receive test tokens on DevNet for deployment and testing.
- [Switch Parties](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/switch-parties.md): Change the primary party used to conduct transactions in Splice Portfolio.
- [Error Handling and Troubleshooting](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/splice-portfolio/troubleshooting.md): Resolve wallet connection problems and system errors in Splice Portfolio.

#### PQS

- [PQS (Participant Query Store)](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/pqs.md): Query ledger data with SQL using PQS, a PostgreSQL-based projection of Canton contract state.
- [Configure](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/pqs/configure.md): Configure PQS data sources, filters, and encoding options.
- [Operate](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/pqs/operate.md): Run, observe, recover, and secure a PQS deployment.
- [Optimize](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/pqs/optimize.md): Tune PQS query performance, including JSONB payload queries.
- [Troubleshoot](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/development-tools/pqs/troubleshoot.md): Diagnose common PQS issues using quick facts, log and metrics analysis, and step-by-step runbooks.

### API Overview

- [Admin API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/admin-api.md): Reference documentation for the Canton Admin API, covering node administration, key management, topology, and party management.

#### Ledger API

- [Ledger API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/ledger-api.md): Overview of the Canton Ledger API: the gRPC and JSON interfaces a participant exposes for command submission, transaction reads, and party management.
- [gRPC Ledger API Services](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/ledger-api-services.md): Service-by-service explanation of the gRPC Ledger API: command submission, completions, updates, state, and the supporting administrative services.
- [JSON API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/json-api.md): HTTP/JSON interface to the Canton Ledger API
- [JSON Ledger API Migration to V2 guide](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/json-ledger-api-migration-to-v2.md)

#### Splice APIs

- [Splice Architecture](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-architecture.md): Daml package structure, decentralized validation and automation, and DSO party requirements for CC and CNS
- [Splice APIs](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-apis.md): Reference documentation for the Scan, Validator, SV, and Daml APIs that run on Canton Network nodes.
- [Splice APIs Overview](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-overview.md): Overview of the REST and gRPC APIs exposed by Splice nodes on the Canton Network
- [Splice HTTP APIs](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-http-apis.md): The HTTP REST APIs exposed by the Scan, Validator, and SV applications
- [Validator APIs](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-validator-api.md): Wallet, user management, external signing, and validator administration APIs

##### Scan APIs

- [Scan APIs](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-api.md): Public, read-only access to Global Synchronizer state, history, and reference data
- [Scan Aggregates API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-aggregates-api.md): Aggregated views over Canton Coin holdings and ANS entries
- [Scan Bulk Data API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-bulk-data-api.md): Full update history and ACS snapshots from the SV participant node
- [Scan Canton Coin Reference Data API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-cc-reference-data-api.md): Canton Coin reference data exposed by the Scan API
- [Scan API for Current State of CC and Synchronizer Traffic](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-current-state-api.md): Open and issuing mining rounds, traffic status, and conversion rates
- [Scan Global Synchronizer Connectivity API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-gs-connectivity-api.md): Discover Scan and sequencer endpoints across all SVs
- [Scan Global Synchronizer Operations API](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-gs-operations-api.md): Validator liveness, DSO info, and governance state
- [Scan Open API Reference](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/splice-scan-openapi.md): Full OpenAPI specification for the Scan API

### Reference Projects

- [cn-quickstart](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/reference-projects/cn-quickstart.md): A full-stack reference application for building on Canton Network, with Daml contracts, Java backend, React frontend, and LocalNet.
- [Splice Reference Apps](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/reference-projects/splice-reference-apps.md): Reference applications from the Splice repository for building Canton Network infrastructure and applications.
